items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: we had some contact with Dr. Ralph Bunch and we asked him to get Charlotte into the International School of the United Nations

ctx.x: We had no way to… couldn‟t find any place where… in our neighborhood the teachers who are here are all tenure and they can decide where they want to teach and so good teachers didn‟t want to come in our neighborhood to teach because they feared that something would happen to them or whatever. They didn‟t choose to come in our community. So we in our community, we always got second rate teachers, beginning teachers, and our children really needed top drawer teachers because the conditions [unintelligible] coming…
